request.description: SUBSTANTIALLY RESCULPT this exact ancient weir boss torso while retaining the same rough silhouette and anatomical identity. It currently looks like a flat stack of parallel grey planks. Replace that with very strong VOLUME: left tower a deep square stone pier showing broad lit TOP and LEFT faces and deep SHADOWED SIDE RETURN, right tower snapped unevenly and stepped, outboard buttresses big trapezoidal stone masses projecting forward, center chest a projecting massive architrave around a DEEPLY RECESSED ring SOCKET. A deep culvert arch separating short massive feet. Make fewer, much larger planar stone pieces with clear negative spaces, each facing a different direction. Make broad bright chalk-slate lit faces and very dark violet slate side faces, 12 restrained stone colors. The sprite must read as a heavy sculptural ruined waterworks facade that has come alive, a menacing architectural guardian, not a robot or flat fence. Beautiful native hard-edged pixel art, great at tiny 1x. No head, no arms, no hands, no crystals, no accessories, no glow, no cyan or teal, no speckle, no texture hatch. Keep SAME 120x112 canvas, heart socket center x60 y49, head notch x60 y34, crystal attachment ledges x24 y9 and x96 y9, footer y107, transparent two-pixel perimeter. Preserve correct asymmetry: left tower taller than broken right tower. Upper-left light, clean dark outline. Change planes boldly and give real stone thickness.
